
name: Create Release Branch

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      release_version:
        description: "Release version (e.g. 2.0)"
        required: true
        type: string
      commit_sha:
        description: "Commit SHA to create the release branch from"
        required: true
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  create-release-branch:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository history
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          ref: base-v2

      - name: Validate commit and release version
        id: validate
        shell: bash
        env:
          RELEASE_VERSION: ${{ inputs.release_version }}
          COMMIT_SHA: ${{ inputs.commit_sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          if [[ ! "$RELEASE_VERSION" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]; then
            echo "Invalid release version. Example: 2.0"
            exit 1
          fi

          if [[ ! "$COMMIT_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{4,40}$ ]]; then
            echo "Invalid commit SHA format."
            exit 1
          fi

          if ! git cat-file -e "${COMMIT_SHA}^{commit}" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "Commit not found in repository history."
            exit 1
          fi

          FULL_SHA=$(git rev-parse "${COMMIT_SHA}^{commit}")
          BRANCH_NAME="release/$RELEASE_VERSION"

          if git ls-remote --exit-code --heads origin \
              "refs/heads/$BRANCH_NAME" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "Branch $BRANCH_NAME already exists."
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "commit_sha=$FULL_SHA" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "branch_name=$BRANCH_NAME" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Create remote release branch
        env:
          COMMIT_SHA: ${{ steps.validate.outputs.commit_sha }}
          BRANCH_NAME: ${{ steps.validate.outputs.branch_name }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          git push origin "$COMMIT_SHA:refs/heads/$BRANCH_NAME"

          echo "Successfully created $BRANCH_NAME"
          echo "Starting commit: $COMMIT_SHA"
